claims.text: The trip record terminates the trip with cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE. POL-NS-01(d) recognises only RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and states in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The four limbs of POL-NS-01 are conjunctive, so the failure of limb (d) alone makes the no-show cancellation fee not chargeable, whatever else the trace shows.

The driver's own trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous 380 seconds across 39 qualifying fixes, from 11:22:26 to 11:28:46. POL-NS-01 provides that where the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius the fee is not chargeable and the ruling is FULL_REFUND of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation, the mis-selected reason code being recorded as a driver-education referral. That is this case exactly.

Independently, the rider is exonerated under POL-NS-04. Limb (a): she sent a locating message, 'at the lift lobby', at 11:23:26 inside the waiting window. Limb (b): the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of that message and placed no in-app voice call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty); his only message was the earlier 'cannot find you, where are you' at 11:22:56, and he never answered hers. Limb (c): her device sat 13.1-19.1 m from the pin across all 65 fixes, well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius for the whole window. The fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation.

No driver compensation is payable on this trip. POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. Limb (d) fails here, so the POL-NS-07 precondition is not met and the driver takes nothing: the 4.50 SGD fee is returned to the rider rather than converted into a payout.

POL-NS-03 does not apply and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. That clause allocates fault only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin. Here the qualifying fixes lie inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, so the wrong-entrance route is simply not reached and no goodwill payment is owed to the driver.

The fare ledger carries exactly one cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50, with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The contested amount is therefore SGD 4.50, and a full refund under POL-NS-01 returns that whole sum to the filing rider.

No artifact in this bundle is impaired, so the refund cannot be discounted or diverted to review. The trip record, GPS trace, chat log, fare ledger and both profiles all carry admissibility status COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0; the confidence in a refund that rests on the driver's own trace is consequently uncapped under POL-GEN-02(2), and none of the POL-NS-09 escalation triggers is engaged.

EV-ADVIS-02747-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0), so no traffic advisory on record supports any kerb-restriction or closure excuse on this pickup road, and POL-NS-06(i) - which requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated - is unavailable. The rider's claim does not rest on that artifact, so its absence can neither defeat the refund nor be turned against her.

claims.text: The driver's own trace satisfies the POL-NS-02 proximity test outright: derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count is 39 consecutive qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius of the registered pickup pin at Blk 231 Serangoon Ave 3 (VEN-SERANGOON-AVE3), the driver's minimum distance to the pin is 0.0 m, and the single in-geofence run begins at 11:22:26 — the exact timestamp of the platform-recorded 'I'm Here' event in the trip record. Arrival under POL-NS-02, and therefore POL-NS-01 limb (b), is made out on the driver's evidence, and the radius is not in doubt: trip_record.pickup_zone_class is STANDARD, so the 50 m figure and the 25 m accuracy filter are the ones that apply.

The arrival marker is not false, so POL-NS-05 cannot be turned against the driver: at the 11:22:26 marker the trace already places him inside the pickup geofence — the qualifying run's first fix is 11:22:26 and his minimum distance to the pin is 0.0 m, far inside POL-NS-05's 300 m ceiling — and stationary, 0.0 kph being among his recorded speeds. There is accordingly neither a >300 m marker nor motion at or above 15 kph to void the waiting clock, the clock is not recomputed, and no false-arrival event falls to be recorded in the referrals under POL-NS-05(ii) or POL-NS-05(iii).

The waiting requirement was exceeded, not missed. The driver held position inside the geofence continuously for 380 seconds, from 11:22:26 to 11:28:46 (derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec, 39 fixes), against the 180 seconds free waiting period in force for this trip under trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; the derived shortfall is −200 seconds, a surplus. POL-NS-06 therefore licenses no refund on waiting-period-shortfall grounds, and because the whole dwell is served inside one continuous in-geofence interval, no accumulation of separate intervals under POL-NS-06(i) is needed and the MISSING traffic advisory at EV-ADVIS-02747-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) is immaterial to the driver's dwell.

Nothing in the driver's record supports the anti-farming concern or any escalation on his side. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the four-or-more limb of the POL-NS-07 check, and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 138 is 0.0145, below the 0.08 rate limb, so the check does not trip on either limb and POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged against this driver. There is no pattern of fee harvesting to justify withholding the cancellation fee from him, and no counterparty-history trigger either: both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not engaged.

The monetary exposure on any refund is bounded by what the ledger actually took. The only charge on this trip is the SGD 4.50 cancellation-fee line: total_charged is 4.50, the waiting_time_fee is 0.00, base fare, distance fare, time fare, surcharges and ERP are all 0.00, and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00. That line reconciles with the net figure in force for the trip, platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50 (the ledger is permitted to show the net SGD 4.50 or the gross SGD 6.61 under POL-NS-08(d)), so no fare-integrity defect exists, no additional sum was charged, and nothing beyond the cancellation-fee line can be ordered.

I do not press a monetary win for the driver on the fee, and I say so plainly rather than stretch the record. The termination is recorded under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE and the driver's own statement — 'Could not locate the rider so I cancelled' — confirms it; POL-NS-01 states in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The fee is therefore not chargeable on this trip however clean the arrival and dwell facts are, and the only driver-side consequence the policy supports on these facts is the referral of the mis-selected reason code as a driver-education item, not any finding of fraud or fee-farming.

ruling.explanation: To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee cannot stand, and it is returned to the rider in full. Why. Under POL-NS-01 a no-show fee is chargeable only if all four conditions hold. The first three are satisfied on the driver's own evidence: the trip record (EV-TRIP-02747) carries the driver's 'I'm Here' event at 11:22:26, and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02747) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius of the Serangoon Ave 3 pin from 11:22:26 to 11:28:46 — 380 continuous seconds across 39 qualifying fixes, minimum distance to the pin 0.0 m — so limb (b) and the 180-second free-waiting dwell in limb (c) (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) are met, and the marker is not a false one (POL-NS-05 is not engaged: no marker more than 300 m out, no motion at or above 15 km/h). Condition (d) fails. The trip was terminated by the driver at 11:28:47 under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and POL-NS-01 states in terms that this code is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d); the driver's own statement of 9 Sep ('Could not locate the rider so I cancelled') confirms it, and the driver's brief concedes the point. Because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, POL-NS-01 fixes the outcome itself: the fee is not chargeable, the ruling is FULL_REFUND, and no driver compensation is payable. Amount. The only charge on the ledger (EV-FARE-02747) is the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 (total_charged 4.50; payment_status CHARGED; refund_issued_sgd 0.00); it reconciles with the net figure in force (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and nothing beyond that line can be ordered. The full SGD 4.50 is returned. The monetary effect is SGD 4.50, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes automatically. Driver compensation is nil. POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full; limb (d) fails, so there is no payout. The anti-farming check does not trip in any event: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the four-or-more limb, and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 138 is 0.0145, below the 0.08 rate limb. No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and no impaired artifact carries a deciding fact. Claims answered. The driver's claims that POL-NS-02 arrival is made out, that the marker is not false under POL-NS-05, and that the 380-second dwell exceeds the free waiting period so POL-NS-06 yields no refund on shortfall grounds are accepted — they are correct and I rely on the trace for exactly those facts — but they do not change the result, because limb (d) independently fails, which the driver's own final claim also concedes. The rider's POL-NS-04 claim (locating message 'at the lift lobby' at 11:23:26 unanswered within 120 s, no in-app call, rider device 13.1–19.1 m from the pin across 65 fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius) is also made out on EV-CHAT-02747 and EV-GPS-02747, but it is not needed: the refund follows from POL-NS-01 alone. The rider's claims that POL-NS-03 pin-ambiguity goodwill does not arise (correct — the qualifying fixes lie inside the radius, so the wrong-entrance route is not reached), that the contested sum is SGD 4.50, and that no artifact is impaired are accepted. Impaired or absent evidence. EV-ADVIS-02747-01 (traffic advisory) is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; it carries no fact and is not needed, because the driver's dwell was one continuous in-geofence interval, so POL-NS-06(i)'s accumulation rule — the only limb that requires an advisory — never comes into play. All other artifacts (trip record, GPS trace, chat log, fare ledger and both profiles) are COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence in this ruling is not capped below 1.0.
referrals: POL-NS-01 — the cancellation was recorded under reason code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE although the driver's stationary fixes lay inside the arrival radius and the fee is refundable; the mis-selected reason code is referred as a driver-education item.

ruling.explanation:
The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee cannot stand, and it is refunded to you in full.

What both sides agree on. The driver did arrive and did wait. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02747) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at Blk 231 Serangoon Ave 3 for a continuous 380 seconds, from 11:22:26 to 11:28:46, across 39 qualifying fixes at 0.0 m minimum distance to the pin, and the trip record's 'I'm Here' tap is at 11:22:26 (EV-TRIP-02747). The free waiting period in force for this trip is 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), so the dwell was served. The Driver Advocate's POL-NS-02 proximity claim and his POL-NS-05 claim are accepted: the arrival marker is not false, there is no motion at 15 kph or more and no >300 m marker, so no false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii) arises.

Why the fee still fails. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only if all four of its conditions hold, and limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated under RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. This trip was terminated by the driver under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE (EV-TRIP-02747), which the clause itself states is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The driver's statement in the dispute ('Could not locate the rider so I cancelled') confirms it, and the Driver Advocate does not press the fee. Because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, POL-NS-01 fixes the outcome on limb (d) itself: the fee is not chargeable, the whole SGD 4.50 is refunded, and no driver compensation is payable.

The same result follows independently for the rider under POL-NS-04, as the Rider Advocate argued: limb (a) - the rider sent a locating message ('at the lift lobby', 11:23:26, inside the waiting window); limb (b) - the driver did not reply within 120 seconds of it and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty (his only message, 'cannot find you, where are you', was sent at 11:22:56, before hers); limb (c) - her device sat 13.1 to 19.1 m from the pin across all 65 fixes, inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius.

Amounts. The only charge on this trip is the cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50, which is total_charged, with waiting-time fee, base, distance and time fares, surcharges and ERP all at 0.00 and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 (EV-FARE-02747). The line reconciles with the net fee in force for the trip, platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50 (the gross SGD 6.61 being the alternative under POL-NS-08(d)), so the fare-integrity claim is accepted and there is no additional sum to order. Driver compensation is null: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limb (d) fails; and POL-NS-03 does not apply, because it governs only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, whereas here they are inside the radius - so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. The driver's anti-farming point is accepted: no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below four) and 2/138 = 0.0145 (below 0.08), so POL-NS-07's check does not trip and POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged, and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not engaged.

Claims accepted but not changing the money. POL-NS-06 is accepted on its own terms - the dwell was 380 seconds against the 180 second minimum, a 200 second surplus, so no waiting-period-shortfall refund route arises and no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is needed; the refund comes from POL-NS-01(d), not from this clause. The rider's claim that no artifact is impaired is accepted as to the deciding artifacts, though it is not literally complete: the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02747-01 is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), but it carries no deciding fact here and so affects neither the outcome nor the confidence cap. The rider's claim resting on that artifact was discarded at the citation stage for failing to name its issue code, and is not relied on.

Confidence and execution. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact - EV-TRIP-02747 (the reason code and the arrival event) and EV-GPS-02747 (the in-radius dwell) - is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is set at 0.95; no POL-NS-09 trigger (including limb (e)) is engaged and the case does not escalate. The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, so it executes automatically on issue, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

The referral above is produced by POL-NS-01 and directs the platform to record the mis-selected reason code for driver education; it rides with the refund and does not displace it.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your claim is upheld and the no-show cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 charged to you on trip TRP-02747 is refunded in full. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02747, weight 1.0) places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at Blk 231 Serangoon Ave 3 from 11:22:26 to 11:28:46 — a continuous in-geofence dwell of 380 seconds (39 qualifying fixes) against the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip, so POL-NS-01 limbs (a), (b) and (c) are made out. Limb (d) is not. The trip was terminated with cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and POL-NS-01(d) recognises only RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT; POL-NS-01 states in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). Because the four limbs are conjunctive and the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, the clause directs a full refund of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation, the mis-selected code being recorded as a driver-education referral. The amount is taken from the fare ledger (EV-FARE-02747: total_charged SGD 4.50, cancellation_fee SGD 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd SGD 0.00) and reconciles with the net figure in force, platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50. The rider's fallback exoneration under POL-NS-04 is also made out (locating message 'at the lift lobby' at 11:23:26, no driver reply within 120 seconds, rider track 13–19 m from the pin throughout), but it adds nothing to a refund already full. POL-NS-03 is not reached: the stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m radius, not outside it within 400 m, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises.

To the driver: your factual points are accepted. The arrival marker is not false — at 11:22:26 you were 0.0 m from the pin and stationary, so neither POL-NS-05 trigger fires and no false-arrival referral is made. Your dwell of 380 seconds exceeded the 180-second free waiting period, so POL-NS-06 licenses no refund and the missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02747-01) is immaterial — it bears only on POL-NS-06(i), and your dwell was served in one continuous in-geofence interval. The fare ledger reconciles to the net figure, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect, and the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 2, below the four-or-more limb, and 2/138 = 0.0145, below the 0.08 rate limb). But POL-NS-07 pays you only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and limb (d) fails: the obstacle is the reason code you selected, not your conduct on the ground. No driver compensation is therefore payable.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires. Nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d): the trace has 100% coverage, no sampling gap and 96 fixes; the arrival event at 11:22:26 matches the first qualifying fix exactly, so there is no clock skew; the chat log is complete at 2 messages with intact sequence numbering and matches trip_record.chat_message_count; and the cancellation-fee line equals the net figure. No admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence; both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the anti-farming limbs are not met. The one discarded claim (see the audit record) rested on the missing advisory EV-ADVIS-02747-01 without naming its issue code and is in any event unnecessary. The deciding facts are carried by the trip record, GPS trace, chat log and fare ledger, all at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes automatically.

ruling.explanation: Rider, your claim is upheld; Driver, the no-show fee cannot stand on this record. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only where all four of its conditions hold together, and condition (d) requires the trip to have been terminated by the driver under RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT. The trip record EV-TRIP-02747 shows the trip cancelled by the driver at 11:28:47 under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, and the driver's own statement ('Could not locate the rider so I cancelled') confirms it; POL-NS-01 states in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). With limb (d) failed the fee is not chargeable, and the surrounding facts put this squarely in the branch POL-NS-01 fixes for a wrong reason code: the GPS trace EV-GPS-02747 places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius continuously for 380 seconds (39 qualifying fixes, 11:22:26 to 11:28:46). So the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the mis-selected reason code goes into the referrals as a driver-education item. The rider independently succeeds under POL-NS-04: she sent a locating message ('at the lift lobby') at 11:23:26 inside the waiting window, the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds and placed no in-app call, and her device sat 13.1-19.1 m from the pin across all 65 fixes, well inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius; that clause also refunds the fee in full with no driver compensation. On the driver's claims: I accept the POL-NS-02 proximity test is met (39 consecutive in-radius fixes, minimum distance 0.0 m), that POL-NS-05 cannot mark the arrival false (the 11:22:26 marker already places him inside the geofence and stationary, far inside the 300 m ceiling and the 15 km/h threshold, so the waiting clock is not recomputed and no false-arrival referral arises), and that POL-NS-06 gives the rider no shortfall route - the 380-second dwell exceeds the 180-second free waiting period in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, the derived shortfall being -200 seconds, a surplus. Those findings do not save the fee, because limb (d) fails independently. I also accept there is no POL-NS-07 anti-farming pattern (no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below four, and 2/138 = 0.0145, below 0.08) and that the fare ledger reconciles with the SGD 4.50 net figure in force under POL-NS-08(d) - but POL-NS-07 pays the driver only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not, so the driver receives nothing; the driver conceded this correctly. The MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02747-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no fact here: the dwell is one continuous in-geofence interval, so no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is needed and its absence neither defeats nor supports the refund. The deciding facts rest on EV-TRIP-02747 and EV-GPS-02747, both COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is not capped and stands at 0.9; no POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is engaged. The rider's claim that cites the missing advisory without naming its issue code is discarded as the referee recorded. The refund of SGD 4.50 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05 and executes automatically.

The four limbs of POL-NS-01 are conjunctive, so the failure of limb (d) alone makes the no-show cancellation fee not chargeable, whatever else the trace shows.

The driver's own trace places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous 380 seconds across 39 qualifying fixes, from 11:22:26 to 11:28:46. POL-NS-01 provides that where the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius the fee is not chargeable and the ruling is FULL_REFUND of the cancellation fee with no driver compensation, the mis-selected reason code being recorded as a driver-education referral. Limb (d) fails here, so the POL-NS-07 precondition is not met and the driver takes nothing: the 4.50 SGD fee is returned to the rider rather than converted into a payout.

POL-NS-03 does not apply and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. That clause allocates fault only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin. Here the qualifying fixes lie inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, so the wrong-entrance route is simply not reached and no goodwill payment is owed to the driver.

The arrival marker is not false, so POL-NS-05 cannot be turned against the driver: at the 11:22:26 marker the trace already places him inside the pickup geofence — the qualifying run's first fix is 11:22:26 and his minimum distance to the pin is 0.0 m, far inside POL-NS-05's 300 m ceiling — and stationary, 0.0 kph being among his recorded speeds. There is accordingly neither a >300 m marker nor motion at or above 15 kph to void the waiting clock, the clock is not recomputed, and no false-arrival event falls to be recorded in the referrals under POL-NS-05(ii) or POL-NS-05(iii).

The waiting requirement was exceeded, not missed. The driver held position inside the geofence continuously for 380 seconds, from 11:22:26 to 11:28:46 (derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec, 39 fixes), against the 180 seconds free waiting period in force for this trip under trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec; the derived shortfall is −200 seconds, a surplus. POL-NS-06 therefore licenses no refund on waiting-period-shortfall grounds, and because the whole dwell is served inside one continuous in-geofence interval, no accumulation of separate intervals under POL-NS-06(i) is needed and the MISSING traffic advisory at EV-ADVIS-02747-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) is immaterial to the driver's dwell.

Nothing in the driver's record supports the anti-farming concern or any escalation on his side. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the four-or-more limb of the POL-NS-07 check, and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 138 is 0.0145, below the 0.08 rate limb, so the check does not trip on either limb and POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged against this driver. There is no pattern of fee harvesting to justify withholding the cancellation fee from him, and no counterparty-history trigger either: both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not engaged.

The monetary exposure on any refund is bounded by what the ledger actually took. The only charge on this trip is the SGD 4.50 cancellation-fee line: total_charged is 4.50, the waiting_time_fee is 0.00, base fare, distance fare, time fare, surcharges and ERP are all 0.00, and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00. That line reconciles with the net figure in force for the trip, platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50 (the ledger is permitted to show the net SGD 4.50 or the gross SGD 6.61 under POL-NS-08(d)), so no fare-integrity defect exists, no additional sum was charged, and nothing beyond the cancellation-fee line can be ordered.

I do not press a monetary win for the driver on the fee, and I say so plainly rather than stretch the record. The termination is recorded under cancellation_reason_code DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE and the driver's own statement — 'Could not locate the rider so I cancelled' — confirms it; POL-NS-01 states in terms that DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is the driver's own admission that he could not find the rider and does not satisfy limb (d). The fee is therefore not chargeable on this trip however clean the arrival and dwell facts are, and the only driver-side consequence the policy supports on these facts is the referral of the mis-selected reason code as a driver-education item, not any finding of fraud or fee-farming.
